There are also curved arrows in the figure, but the question requires ignoring the arrows. Reasoning count: Count by fragments and do not count hydrogen-related bonds. The phenyl ring internally has 6 heavy-atom bonds. Non-phenyl substrate connections include: 1 Ph–chiral carbon, 1 chiral carbon–OH oxygen, 1 chiral carbon–alkene carbon, the C=C double bond in the figure counted as 2 bonds, 1 enolate carbon–O−, 1 enolate carbon–methyl carbon, and 1 substrate alkene carbon–DABCO N+, for a total of 8.
